_README: LOCAL secrets for the phone-login Worker. Copy this file to secrets.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR OWN values. They are pushed to Cloudflare with `wrangler secret put`. NEVER commit secrets.json, never paste its values into a chat.
_green: Only when OTP_PROVIDER is green, or Green is the fallback.
GREEN_API_ID_2: <optional: a second instance on a DIFFERENT WhatsApp number, as backup>
_meta_direct: Only when sending through Meta straight from the Worker.
META_TOKEN: <a permanent System User token with whatsapp_business_messaging>
_meta_relay: Only when sending through the sendLoginOtp function in the Base44 app. Generate a long random value and set the SAME value as a secret in the app.
_proxy: Only when the login page is served through the phoneLogin function on the app's domain. Generate a long random value and set the SAME value as PHONE_LOGIN_PROXY_SECRET in the app.
_generated: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET and OIDC_PRIVATE_KEY are NOT entered here. `npm run keygen` generates them into KEYS.local.json.
